meta.name: renobattery-seo
meta.philosophy: Let a dedicated SEO plugin (Rank Math or Yoast) handle titles/descriptions/canonicals/sitemaps. The theme ships battery-industry schema that those plugins don't know about, plus safe defensive fallbacks for head meta when no SEO plugin is active.

plugin_compatibility.recommended: Rank Math (free) or Yoast SEO — theme detects presence and yields head emission to plugin where overlap exists.

head_meta.canonical: emitted by SEO plugin; theme fallback only if plugin absent
head_meta.robots: SEO plugin; fallback = noindex,follow for search/tag/author archives
head_meta.open_graph: SEO plugin; fallback outputs og:title, og:description, og:image (thumbnail size rb-hero), og:type, og:url, og:site_name, og:locale

shape.name: Renobattery
shape.description: Battery manufacturer — LiFePO₄ modular energy storage.

BreadcrumbList.shape: position-indexed ItemList from WP hierarchy + taxonomy + post-type archive

emitted_on: optional: single product if FAQ ACF block exists
FAQPage.shape: Question/Answer pairs from a repeater — not yet wired, stubbed

sitemap.strategy: Rank Math / Yoast generate XML sitemap. Theme just ensures CPTs are listed.
sitemap.bilingual: Polylang auto-adds <xhtml:link rel='alternate' hreflang=...> lines inside each URL entry.

robots_txt.recommendation: Let WordPress generate the virtual robots.txt (handled by SEO plugin). Key directives:

heading_structure.h2_h3_usage: Section eyebrows are <span>, section headlines are <h2>. Widgets/cards use <h3>. Subsections use <h4>.

image_seo.alt_policy: Required for all content images (ACF `image` fields store alt; WP media library alt respected). Decorative images use alt=''.
image_seo.lazy_loading: native loading='lazy', above-fold uses loading='eager' + fetchpriority='high'
image_seo.srcset: handled by WP core + add_image_size in theme-setup.php

performance_seo_intersection: Core Web Vitals targets defined in step-06-performance.json
